name: 1920 Agency
summary: A full-service marketing team helping businesses with ads, search, social media, video, websites and AI tools. Editorial typography on near-black surfaces, controlled violet accents, real project imagery. Imported from the approved website foundation v1.0 (locked 28 Sep 2026); ad and social rules added where the source is silent are marked proposed.

ownership.note: The agency owner's own brand. Served only to the owner's tenant (BRANDS_OWNER_TENANT_ID).

approval.rule: Changes to the colours, type, logo or signature graphics are a new version of the approved foundation and need the owner's explicit yes; record the date and reason. Proposed values are not approved until the owner confirms them.

sources.note: Version 1.3, approved foundation v1.0 (28 Sep 2026). Its v1.3 'current adopted website rules' take precedence over its older component measurements.
The approved, locked homepage. FOUNDATION-LOCK.md: its rendered CSS takes precedence over conflicting guide examples.
Untouched originals; the copies here match the SHA-256 values in sources.json.
The site's self-hosted Manrope (weights 200-800 per the homepage @font-face). Licence text from github.com/google/fonts ofl/manrope/OFL.txt.

Only its formats, story safe zones, minimum text sizes and never-on-image list are used here. Its colours and Geist type are the owner's PERSONAL brand (Zain-Personal-Branding), not 1920 Agency, so none of them are imported.

sources.ref: Rules written for ads and social posts where the 1920 sources say nothing, built only from the values above.

colors.name: Deep Onyx
colors.use: Main canvas, navigation, large dark surfaces. About 75-85% of a composition.

colors.name: Electric Violet
colors.use: Primary actions, selected states, signature graphics. 5-8% of a composition. Never for text on Onyx.

colors.name: Amethyst Tint
colors.use: Eyebrows, secondary emphasis, icons, highlights, glow, focus rings. 2-5% of a composition.

colors.name: Pure Stark White
colors.use: Headings, body copy, proof points. 8-15% of a composition.

colors.name: Display muted
colors.use: Only for large display text; never small or critical text.

colors.name: Text on light
colors.use: Text on the lavender and pearl project stages.

colors.name: Violet deep
colors.use: Second stop of the CTA gradient; not a separate brand colour.

colors.name: Lavender stage
colors.use: Light stop of the lavender project-stage gradient only.

contrastPairs.note: Approved for all text sizes and essential UI.
Approved for body text, labels, icons and focus states.
Approved for CTA labels and selected controls.
Decorative shapes only: use White or Amethyst for meaningful text and interaction cues.
4.33:1: large display text only, as the guide says.
The CTA label stays readable across the whole gradient.

gradients.name: Primary CTA
gradients.use: Primary buttons, with White text. The guide writes linear-gradient(115deg, #7B2CBF, #5D1F95); the approved homepage renders this one, and the homepage wins.

gradients.name: Hero text
gradients.use: One short phrase in a major heading. Never on paragraphs. The guide's three-stop version (to #7B2CBF) is superseded by the homepage.

gradients.name: Ambient glow
gradients.use: Soft background glow behind a focal point.

gradients.name: Onyx with glow
gradients.use: Canvas for ads and social posts: Onyx with one soft violet glow at the top.

families.name: Manrope
families.role: The only brand family: display, headings, body and labels. No second display font.

licence.name: SIL Open Font License 1.1
licence.notes: Copyright 2018 The Manrope Project Authors. No Reserved Font Name, so self-hosting and subsetting are allowed; keep the licence text with every copy. The file is the site's own copy, unchanged.

scale.sample: We help your business grow online
One team to bring it all together.
Tell us what you have in mind. Save time with AI.

rules: Sentence case for headings and buttons. Uppercase only for short section labels, category tags and decorative bands.
Tracking: display about -0.055em, section headings -0.035em, body normal, uppercase eyebrows +0.14em to +0.20em.
16px for substantive body copy; meaningful labels and controls 14-16px; never put essential meaning in 6-10px microtype.
Body reading width 45-70 characters; hero description about 390px wide.
One H1 per page and a logical H2/H3 outline. Avoid em dashes in website headings.
Gradient text on one short phrase within a major heading only; paragraphs stay solid.
Section spacing 105px desktop, 80px intermediate, 65px mobile; major features 120-140px where the content justifies it.
Component gaps 16-32px. Large split sections 48-100px desktop, 24-40px mobile.
Generous margins and a quiet background around major statements: space creates emphasis.

radii.use: Actions, filters and round icon controls (v1.3: pill actions).

layout.gutters: 5% desktop, 6% mobile, never under 20px. Outer page wrapper 1600px at most.
layout.grid: Planning grid of 12 columns desktop, 8 intermediate, 4 mobile; pages use purpose-built CSS grids.
rules: Hero: about half copy and half art, heading clear of the sculpture; on mobile stack copy, actions, then art.
Never overlay essential body copy on artwork. No fixed heights on text containers.
Test 320, 390, 768, 1024, 1440 and 1920px widths, plus zoom and long content.

files.name: Primary logo, white horizontal (transparent)
files.use: The website primary and the default on every creative. Header 156px wide desktop / 128px mobile; footer 180px / 156px.

files.name: Square icon (four circles)
files.use: Avatars, app icons and favicons. Fine detail softens at very small sizes.

logo.clearSpace: At least 25% of the displayed logo height on every side.

minSize.note: 128px wide is the mobile header size. The horizontal originals are 200px rasters: do not enlarge them past native size for print, and do not call the display SVGs vector masters.

do: Use the supplied original files exactly as they are.
Place them on Deep Onyx or another dark brand panel; on a light layout, put the original on a dark panel.
Keep the aspect ratio and the clear space.
Use the square four-circle version for avatars and icons.
dont: Never trace, recolour, redraw, outline or add effects to the logo.
Never recreate the lettering in a font, or type '1920 Agency' as a logo.
Never stretch, rotate or animate the letters independently (the website's approved reveal is the only motion).
Never use the retired Connected Progress or other generated logo concepts.
Never use the 500px black-canvas reference image in place of the transparent original.
logo.licence: The agency's own trademark artwork, supplied by the owner. For 1920 Agency work only; not a general redistribution kit.

imagery.style: Authentic project, team and process imagery on near-black: real screenshots in dark browser frames over lavender, charcoal or pearl stages; soft, directional lighting; sculptural violet geometry (orbits, signal star, flow ribbon) as one dominant graphic per composition.
do: Use real portfolio screenshots with accurate project names; client colours stay inside their frame.
Use one dominant graphic per composition; secondary shapes faint and at the edges.
Natural skin tones and quiet, thoughtful framing for people.
SVG for vectors and icons, WebP or AVIF for new photography, explicit dimensions.
dont: No stock portraits presented as clients, staff or testimonials.
No rainbow iridescence, cyan highlights, metallic gold or bright green as brand decoration.
No generic stock business illustrations, clutter or glass on every card.
Never manufacture or alter client results in a screenshot.

icons.style: Small, authentic tool and platform marks (original SVG geometry, monochrome white, 14-18px) inside illustrations; Adobe marks keep their colours on 20px tiles.
rules: Icons supplement labels; never replace a label without an accessible name.
Use 2-5 marks around an illustration and keep the central message clear.
Keep each mark's original geometry; sources and licences are recorded in the site's assets/tools/. No partnership is implied.
Write like an informed creative partner: clear, energetic, specific and human. Use 'we' for the agency and 'you' for the reader.
Plain language a grade 7-8 reader can follow: short sentences, familiar words, one idea at a time.
Explain what a service does before listing tools. Explain AI with practical examples (answering questions, handling repeat tasks).
Headings 3-8 words; CTAs a clear action of 2-5 words.
Keep claims, reach, response times, ratings and client outcomes evidence-led. Never invent scale, results, reviews or dates.
Spell services out: 'Search engine optimization', not 'SEO', in headings and rotating service lines.
Markets served are 'Pakistan, Bahrain, the UK and the USA'; the base is Islamabad. Never imply an office where there is none.

examples.say: We help your business grow online.
examples.avoid: Measurable momentum for your digital ambition.

examples.say: Tell us what you have in mind.
Prepare my enquiry (when nothing is sent)
examples.avoid: Send message (when nothing is actually sent)

rules: Recipe from the guide: logo with clear space, one short message, one signature graphic or genuine project image, a restrained CTA.
Rebuild the hierarchy for each format; never crop a whole web page into a post.
Gradient text on one phrase only; everything else solid White or Amethyst on Onyx.
At 1080px wide: body text at least 34px and no text under 24px (Social-Render's checks).
Never on an image: links, digit runs of 8 or more (account, campaign or pixel IDs), tokens, 'swipe', or the product's working name.
Static compositions where the channel ignores reduced-motion settings.
Every result, rating or client claim on an ad needs evidence; otherwise leave it out.

placements.name: Feed square
rules: Social-Render square margins: 80px sides, 72px top, 76px bottom.

placements.name: Feed portrait
rules: The default for feed posts and carousels (Social-Render's portrait format).
Margins: 88px sides, 84px top, 96px bottom.

placements.name: Story / Reel
rules: Keep copy out of the top 250px and bottom 340px app overlays.
Check the real placement preview before launch; overlay sizes change.

sample.headline: We help your business grow online
sample.body: One team to bring it all together.
sample.note: Sample built only from approved wording (the core expression, the supporting line and the header CTA). The layout is a proposed ad recipe, not an approved campaign.

socialTemplates.name: Brand statement
socialTemplates.purpose: One short brand message with the logo and one signature graphic.
structure: One short message with one gradient phrase
One signature graphic (orbit, signal star or flow ribbon)
rules: Matches design-system/social-examples/01-brand-statement-square.svg.

socialTemplates.name: Service post
socialTemplates.purpose: Explain one service in plain words, then name the tools.
structure: Eyebrow with the service name, spelled out
What we do, in one sentence
Two to five tool marks in the illustration
rules: Matches design-system/social-examples/02-service-portrait.svg.
Explain the service before listing tools; promise no result.

socialTemplates.name: Creative story
socialTemplates.purpose: A vertical story built for the format, not a cropped post.
structure: Logo inside the top safe area
One statement in the middle third
Real project image or signature graphic
rules: Matches design-system/social-examples/03-creative-story.svg.

socialTemplates.name: Carousel
socialTemplates.purpose: One idea per slide, the way the guide asks for presentations.
structure: Closing slide with one next step
rules: Dark slides throughout; one gradient phrase per slide.
A counter (01 / 06) is allowed; no 'swipe'.

components.name: Primary button
components.label: Talk to us
components.spec: Violet gradient, White text, pill, semibold, optional north-east arrow. 17px 23px padding; at least 44px tall.
rules: Hover: up to 3px lift and a brighter glow.
Focus: 2px light-purple outline, 4-5px offset.
Loading keeps its width and says what it is doing.

components.name: Quiet button
components.label: See our work
components.spec: Transparent, visible neutral border, White text, pill.
rules: Use a link for navigation and a button for an action.

components.name: Card
components.label: Search engine optimization
components.spec: Raised panel on Surface with a subtle border, 20px radius.
rules: Do not nest interactive elements inside a fully clickable card.
Glass only for small floating annotations.

components.name: Informational tag
components.label: GEO / AI search
components.spec: Small text, 4px radius, quiet border; not interactive.
rules: Never make an informational tag look clickable.

components.name: Text field
components.label: Your email
components.spec: Persistent label above, 16px input text, visible boundary.
rules: Placeholder is an example, never the only label.
Errors in words, linked with aria-describedby.

components.name: Text link
components.label: Read the case study
components.spec: Amethyst text with a directional arrow.
rules: Active links use purple text plus an underline, never colour alone.
Hover 200-300ms; reveal 750ms with 24px travel, once per element; easing cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1).
No more than one dominant moving element in a viewport. No scroll hijacking, cursor replacement or flashing.
Respect prefers-reduced-motion from the first frame; offer pause where motion is continuous.
